SELECT * FROM review_cards WHERE user_id=#{user} AND id=#{id} AND status='active' FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.* FROM review_cards c JOIN books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE c.user_id=#{user} AND c.status='active' AND c.due_at <=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND b.status='completed' AND b.visibility='public' AND b.moderation_status IN ('unreviewed','approved') AND b.asset_scope IN ('private','verified-shared') ORDER BY c.due_at,c.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_cards c JOIN books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE c.user_id=#{user} AND c.status='active' AND c.due_at <=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) AND b.status='completed' AND b.visibility='public' AND b.moderation_status IN ('unreviewed','approved') AND b.asset_scope IN ('private','verified-shared')

SELECT MIN(c.due_at) FROM review_cards c JOIN books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE c.user_id=#{user} AND c.status='active' AND b.status='completed' AND b.visibility='public' AND b.moderation_status IN ('unreviewed','approved') AND b.asset_scope IN ('private','verified-shared')

SELECT c.* FROM review_cards c JOIN books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE c.user_id=#{user} AND c.status='active' AND b.status='completed' AND b.visibility='public' AND b.moderation_status IN ('unreviewed','approved') AND b.asset_scope IN ('private','verified-shared') AND c.kind=#{kind} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_cards c JOIN books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE c.user_id=#{user} AND c.status='active' AND b.status='completed' AND b.visibility='public' AND b.moderation_status IN ('unreviewed','approved') AND b.asset_scope IN ('private','verified-shared') AND c.kind=#{kind}
